text:
Nina Rao: Quick heads-up 14C54E2 AtlasCloud Summit is Fri. We're co-running a live lab (Redwood + EdgeNode). Need to lock speaker roster, demo rollback path, marketplace timing, swag handoff, and on-site volunteers.

Carlos Mejia: I can own demo routing and observability. Primary: EdgeNode appliance in booth rack (private). Fallback: Redwood Dedicated (us-east-1). Will add Prometheus metrics + Grafana dashboard to shared space. Will pre-warm KV cache during dry-run.

Eve Summers: Speaker lineup draft: Nina (product overview), Carlos (infra/deploy), Marta (EdgeNode eng), then 10m Qs. Requesting a 20m demo slot + 10m Q&A. Need final bios + slides by Wed EOD.

Tom Becker: Swag/kitting update: crate shipped today via QuickFreight. Kit SKU = RDW-ATLAS-LABKIT, qty 8 crates (each ~6 demo units). Packing manifest: https://drive.example/rdw/atlas/packing_manifest.pdf. Noted customs: need ECCN & commercial invoice for hardware. Pinged legal.

Logistics-bot: Reminder: venue requires liability waiver for demo hardware. Waiver submitted by Tom; approval pending.

Carlos Mejia: Failover policy proposal: if p50 > 250ms OR error(5xx) > 0.5% sustained for 30s, flip traffic to Dedicated. Add a runtime flag `remote_fallback=true` and a webhook to notify Atlas ops on switch.

Carlos Mejia: Quick test script for preflight (run from staging):

```
# failover smoke test - run 100 concurrent pings
for i in $(seq 1 100); do
  curl -s -H "X-RW-Routing: edge-primary" -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"input":"ping"}' &
done
wait
```

Eve Summers: AV checklist: spare ethernet cables, PoE injector, serial console cable, HDMI splitter, USB-C -> HDMI dongles, small UPS (2x). Need one onsite volunteer to be present 90min before start. @Tom can take morning setup shift?

Tom Becker: I can be onsite AM setup lead. I'll arrive Fri 07:45 local for staging and run a full dry-run at 08:30. QuickFreight AWB: QF890123. Local contact: Priya +44-7700-9001.

Nina Rao: Marketplace / announcement timing: Atlas wants listing live same day at 14:00 local, and a joint tweet T+30m. Marketing needs three copy variants (short, caption, long). Legal needs to signoff on copy by Wed noon.

Carlos Mejia: Observability hooks: sending traces to shared OTLP collector, Grafana panel URL: https://grafana.internal/redwood/atlas-live. Also create a small SLO: error_rate < 0.5% during demo window. If breached, automated fallback should trigger.

Logistics-bot: Calendar invites: rehearsal Thu 17:00 PT; booth dry-run Fri 08:30 local. Invites sent to speaker list.

Nina Rao: Action items recap: @Carlos - complete failover automation + test by Thu EOD; @Tom - confirm customs clearance + bring UPS + onsite contact by Thu noon; @Eve - finalize slides, speaker bios, and tweet copy by Wed EOD; @Legal - ECCN + copy signoff by Wed noon. Reply with :white_check_mark: when you2\tre done.

Carlos Mejia: :white_check_mark: will run tests Thu.

Tom Becker: :white_check_mark: shipping docs to customs team now.

Eve Summers: :white_check_mark: slides + bios on Drive (link in thread).

Logistics-bot: Note: bring two printed emergency contact sheets for booth staff.
